name: Ranjan Gogoi — CJI to Rajya Sabha
verdict: Presided over Ayodhya verdict, Rafale review dismissal, NRC matters
postRetirement: Nominated to Rajya Sabha by the government

name: Abhijit Gangopadhyay — Judge to BJP Politician
verdict: Aggressively pursued teacher recruitment scam cases; strong anti-TMC oral observations; unusual media visibility for a sitting judge
postRetirement: Joined BJP, contested Lok Sabha elections

name: Rohit Arya — Controversial Judge to BJP Member
verdict: Denied bail to comedian Munawar Faruqui (2021); multiple politically sensitive judgments; accused of ideological bias while on bench
postRetirement: Joined BJP; publicly praised BNS; aligned with Modi govt's legal reforms

name: Ranjan Gogoi — Rajya Sabha Performance
verdict: Zero questions asked, zero private member bills, one debate participation, below-average attendance across 6-year tenure
postRetirement: Rajya Sabha MP — widely seen as a reward, not a role

name: Yashwant Varma — Cash Scandal
verdict: Rs 15 crore in burnt cash found at Delhi residence after Holi fire (Mar 2025); denied any connection
postRetirement: Internal committee recommended impeachment — pending with government

name: V. Ramaswami — Political Protection of a Judge
verdict: Faced 14 charges of financial irregularities and extravagant spending as Chief Justice of Punjab & Haryana HC; inquiry committee found him guilty of misconduct
postRetirement: Ruling Congress party abstained from voting — motion failed despite majority support among attending MPs

name: Soumitra Sen — Resigned to Dodge Impeachment
verdict: Found guilty by Rajya Sabha of misappropriating public money he handled as a court-appointed receiver before becoming a judge
retired: Resigned before Lok Sabha could vote
postRetirement: First judge impeached by Rajya Sabha — but resigned just in time to avoid formal removal. No prosecution followed.
